DOWNFALL-PRISMATIC_OPTION.title: Kaleidoscope and Prismatic Gem Option
DOWNFALL-PRISMATIC_OPTION.hover.desc:
Controls which characters' cards Kaleidoscope and Prismatic Gem can pull from (doesn't affect other mods).

Same: only Downfall cards if you're a Downfall character, vanilla cards if you're a base-game character.
DOWNFALL-HIDE_AUTOMATON.title: Hide Automaton
DOWNFALL-HIDE_AUTOMATON.hover.desc: Hides Automaton from the character select and compendium. It stays registered and its cards can still appear in runs.

DOWNFALL-UPLOAD_METRICS.title: Upload Gameplay Data
DOWNFALL-UPLOAD_METRICS.hover.desc:
Gameplay data is sent to help fix bugs and balance the mod. Only sent when playing as a Downfall character.

Personally identifying information is NOT collected.
